body.x: iRobot showed off their AVA robot.It is not a real product yet, though a version of this is being made for a medical application (telepresence for the doctor). It uses 3D imaging, laser and sonar to navigate and avoid bumping into objects and people.People can interact with it with voice, gestures and touch. The height adjusts up and down as needed. It doesn't do windows.Go to CES 2012 Special pageSource
